articles.summary: Tank Car Retrofit Order Removed from Full-Year Outlook and Backlog Full-Year 2026 Outlook Revised Across Railcar Deliveries, Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA Full Third Quarter 2026 Results to Be Released on Monday, November 9, 2026, with Conference Call on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET CHICAGO, Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - FreightCar America, Inc. (NASDAQ: RAIL) (“FreightCar America” or the “Company”), a diversified manufacturer and supplier of railroad freight cars, railcar parts and components, today updated its outlook for fiscal year 2026 and reported preliminary results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Tank Car Retrofit Order The Company has elected to remove 1,285 railcars related to its tank car retrofit order from its backlog because the Company believes that the customer in question is unlikely to be able to meet its obligations under the associated customer contract. articles.summary: Acquisition strengthens the Company's expanding aftermarket platform and broadens its product portfolio, customer relationships and distribution capabilities CHICAGO, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - FreightCar America, Inc. (NASDAQ: RAIL) ("FreightCar America" or the "Company"), a diversified manufacturer and supplier of railroad freight cars, railcar parts and components, today announced that it has completed the acquisition of Trinity Equipment Company ("TEC"), an independent, Michigan-based supplier of OEM and replacement railcar components and fastening solutions. TEC brings complementary products and established customer and supplier relationships across North America. The acquisition broadens the range of components available through FreightCar America’s network and creates opportunities to grow sales to both new and existing customers.
